actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The manticore makes two attacks, one with its bite and
one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11
(2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.
Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 14
Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a
failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
